data: Which of the following nodes in the right graph does not have an arrow pointing to it?

The question asks which node in the right graph does not have an arrow pointing to it. From the analysis of the left graph, we can see that all three nodes (1, 2, and 3) have arrows pointing to them. In the right graph, there is no arrow pointing to node 3. Therefore, the answer is node 3.
